description: With cas.first_data_timeout_ms unset, the Called node's first-data wait covers the transmissions one largest DATA C_PDU needs on the slowest ladder rung after D_PDU overheads, plus a retransmission and the turn, one answer wait each, and the soft link minimum hold follows it.
note: Flow as cas-make-called-first-data-timeout up to the link being made, with cas.first_data_timeout_ms unset and a drc.table, and the run ends once the link's timers have started. At 2000, from 0.0.1.3 (EOT 10), a type 8 D_PDU carrying a PHYSICAL LINK REQUEST with the Ed4 bit set, which records 0.0.1.3 Ed4 (B-0408); the CAS answers PHYSICAL LINK ACCEPTED, sent at 52000 after the contention wait of 45000 (seed 0, slot 15), at drc.default_speed WN 2 Long since 0.0.1.3 has sent no recommendation. The table's thresholds list is empty, so the burst at 1000 to 3000 gives no estimate and 0.0.1.3, heard and recorded Ed4, is owed MAX-SEGMENT alone, 0xAFF (value 255 to a sender that has sent no SENDER-APPROACH; interp C-1271, C-1272), and no top priority. With a calibrated table this node sends its SENDER-APPROACH, 0xB04, first in a transmission that carries data to the peer, here the type 8 D_PDU (interp C-1286), so the accept carries 0xB04 in place of the template's CAPABILITY 0xF01; that D_PDU differs only in its EOW and header CRC. The link is made at 57550 (B-0213, B-0400) and cas.first_data/0.0.1.3 starts (B-0215, B-0216), then the SIS soft link timers, unset and so derived (A-0321). The derived first-data wait (interp B-0420, revised corpus 0.33.0; corpus-format.md section 6): n answer waits, n = max(3, ceil(2054 / c) + 2), where 2054 bytes is the largest DATA C_PDU (1-octet C_PCI, B-0111; 5-octet S_PCI with a TTD, A-0160; a 2048-byte U_PDU at the MTU, A-0047) and c the user bytes one transmission of the configured length carries on the ladder's slowest rung, ladder[0], after D_PDU overheads: b = floor((min(127500, dts.max_transmission_ms) - preamble_ms - flush_ms) / block_ms) blocks, at least 1, hold k = b x block_bytes - modem.eom_bytes bytes (C-0551, C-1042, C-1290), cut into DATA-ONLY D_PDUs of at most dts.max_segment_size bytes, each with o = 23 bytes of overhead (2 sync, C-0082; a 10-byte header with its CRC, C-0111, C-0175; the largest address field, 7, C-0074; the 4-byte CRC-32, C-0157), so with s = dts.max_segment_size, q = floor(k / (s + o)) and r = k - q x (s + o), c = q x s + max(0, r - o). The 2 added waits are a retransmission and the turn, the floor's own reasoning. c below 1 gives n = 3. The answer wait is the derived dts.ack_wait (C-1120): min(127500, dts.max_transmission_ms) + max(lbt_wait_dcd_ms, lbt_wait_vdcd_ms) + num_cont_slots x cont_slot_width_ms. Here dts.max_transmission_ms is 30000, dts.max_segment_size the default 1023, and the ladder is WN 1 Long then WN 2 Long, with a fixture entry for WN 1 Long of 50 bytes and 9600 ms a block. The answer wait is 30000 + 30000 + 16 x 3000 = 108000. On WN 1 Long b = floor((30000 - 600 - 150) / 9600) = 3, k = 3 x 50 - 0 = 150, q = 0, r = 150, c = 150 - 23 = 127, and ceil(2054 / 127) = 17 (16 x 127 = 2032 is short), so n = 19 and cas.first_data/0.0.1.3 starts with 19 x 108000 = 2052000 (corpus 0.33.0, without overheads or the 2 added waits: 14 x 108000 = 1512000; before that three answer waits, 324000). With sis.soft_link_min_hold_ms unset and the first-data wait derived above three answer waits, the minimum hold follows it (interp A-0321, revised corpus 0.34.0): 2052000. The idle wait stays three answer waits, 324000, and the maximum six, 648000; a share-channel close that falls due before the minimum hold ends waits for it (interp A-0326). The accept transmission lasts 5550 ms, inside the 30000 limit, so nothing before the link is made changes.
